# Stale accumulation of LLM-derived entities

Because deterministic-only compiles explicitly prevent removal of LLM-derived entities and their related pages/edges, if LLM-family runs are infrequent or never executed, LLM-derived entities can accumulate and remain stale in the system.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_diff.py` — `tests.test_diff.test_llm_entities_survive_deterministic_only_compile`
